messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novadata.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: NovaData - Procurement & Marketplace Path / follow-up

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call + next steps so your procurement and legal teams have what they need.

Call recap:
- Primary use: NovaData plans to put a low-latency reranking / summarization layer in front of their analytics product (estimated 100k tokens/day initially).
- SLA needs: 99.9% target, option for Dedicated if needed.
- Security: SOC 2 + customer-managed keys are important.
- Procurement: Procurement will either do a standard PO (net-30/45) or buy through AWS Marketplace 

  - they are leaning toward PO but evaluating marketplace for easier renewal billing.

Questions / asks I promised to follow up on:
1) Procurement path preference (PO vs card vs AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace) - if you expect a PO, do you have standard vendor/supplier forms or a PO template?
2) Timeline: when would legal/procurement start review? Any blackout dates for approvals?
3) Security packet: I attached a short SOC2 summary and our standard SOW draft for initial scope. If you need the full SOC2 report or security questionnaire, we can provide / fill out an RFP template.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll share SOC2 summary + SOW now (attached).
- If you want to use AWS Marketplace, I can connect you with our marketplace onboarding specialist and share the marketplace quoting path (saves manual invoicing).
- If PO path, please send a PO template and any standard contract redlines - we'll loop in legal.
- Schedule a 30-minute procurement sync late this week?

Thanks - happy to run the procurement checklist with you.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaData - Procurement & Marketplace Path / follow-up

Camila -

Thanks for the recap and the materials. A few quick answers from our side: 

1) Procurement path: Procurement prefers doing a PO (our standard process). They do use Marketplace for some SaaS purchases but only for renewals - first procurement is usually a PO so we can record the spend. If Marketplace makes invoicing easier for us long-term, we may switch, but initial purchase will likely be PO.

2) Timeline: Procurement & Legal will start review next week. We typically close procurement in 4-8 weeks depending on redlines. We have a finance month-end on May 10 that will delay approvals if we're not through by then.

3) Security: SOC2 summary looks good. They will request the full SOC2 Type II report or an AICPA bridge letter if available. Also please confirm whether Redwood supports SSO via SAML and whether we can use our KMS for encryption.

Procurement asks:
- Can you send a vendor packet with your W9 and any standard master services agreement (MSA)?
- PO terms: we usually do net-30, but some vendors require net-45. Will Redwood accept net-30?

We can set up a procurement call with Priya (cc) and our legal counsel if that helps. Ideally we'd have an initial SOW and pricing to attach to the PO.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product, NovaData
alex.turner@novadata.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@novadata.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@novadata.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaData - Procurement & Marketplace Path / follow-up

Hi Priya / Alex -

Thanks for the details. Quick answers: 

- Net terms: Redwood standard is net-30; we can accept net-30 for this engagement. Please confirm on the PO template whether you need a specific billing contact and whether PO should reference the SOW line items.
- Marketplace: We do publish on AWS Marketplace and can offer a marketplace procurement path. For initial transactions the Marketplace path sometimes requires a differential quoting approach - we typically recommend PO for first purchase to avoid onboarding timing issues, but we'll support whichever path you prefer.
- Security: We support SAML SSO and can provide a KMS/HSM integration summary. I can route a full SOC2 Type II or bridge letter to your security team - let me know the best secure channel (we can use an S3 presigned link or our secure upload form).

Attachments: I've attached our standard MSA template and a vendor packet (W9 + bank remittance stub). Also re-attached the SOW draft and SOC2 summary.

Next steps: 
- Priya: can you please send your PO template and vendor onboarding checklist?
- Alex: I'll set up a 30-minute procurement sync on Thursday 4/29 at 11am PT - propose calendar invite unless that conflicts.
- I'll also introduce our marketplace onboarding specialist (cc to follow) if you want to explore the marketplace route in parallel.

If helpful, Jonas and I can also provide a ballpark invoice-friendly quoting option so procurement can see both PO and marketplace price comparisons.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Invoice/remit info: Redwood Inference, 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103; Tax ID: 94-1234567; remit to accounts.payable@redwood.com. I've filled the vendor onboarding form and attached it here.

- Marketplace timing: onboarding typically takes 2-3 weeks to complete seller enablement. It can run in parallel with legal review but is not a blocker for initial PO issuance. I'll introduce Sarah (Marketplace Onboarding) in a separate thread to coordinate.
